experiment: E-S1-0 — is there a TARGET for S1's climb-out?

prereg.how_to_verify: git ls-files -s -- 'TanitAD Research Hub/Architecture & Inference/Implementation/incoming/2026-08-03-s1-climbout/PREREG_S1_CLIMBOUT.md' && git hash-object 'TanitAD Research Hub/Architecture & Inference/Implementation/incoming/2026-08-03-s1-climbout/PREREG_S1_CLIMBOUT.md'   # must match

thresholds.estimator: paired_episode_cluster_bootstrap / episode_cluster_bootstrap, unit = episode, n_boot = 2000; overlapping_holdout_se NEVER
thresholds.S1_TARGET_EXISTS: ADE(B-both) - ADE(shipped) separated AND <= -0.02 m AND LATERAL not separated worse AND C-leak gap < 50 %
thresholds.S1_NOT_SEPARATED: CI includes 0 => S1 IS DEAD AFTER ALL (§4.4)
thresholds.S1_ADVERSE: separated AND worse => S1 IS DEAD AFTER ALL, more strongly
thresholds.LON_LEVER_LIVE: ADE(C-lon) - ADE(shipped) separated AND <= -0.02 m AND the LONGITUDINAL family separated better
thresholds.registered_prediction: B-both S1-NOT-SEPARATED; C-lon LON-LEVER-NULL at ~55 % confidence; S1b HYGIENE; overall §4.4 fires and S1 is reported DEAD
thresholds.direction_predicate: EVERY trigger reads 'separated AND the delta favours the treatment' — a trigger satisfied literally while its controls beat the score is what happened to S3

parent.how_to_verify: git ls-files -s -- 'Project Steering/PREREG_D-SEL_REFC_SELECTION_SURFACE.md' && git hash-object 'Project Steering/PREREG_D-SEL_REFC_SELECTION_SURFACE.md'  # must match

thresholds.S1_FREE_WIN: E-SEL-0 paired dADE@2s separated AND >= 0.02 m better
thresholds.S1_NEEDS_TRAINING: E-SEL-0 not separated AND C-shuffled clearly worse than refined (frac_sel_2x_worse gap >= 0.05)
thresholds.S1_DEAD: E-SEL-0 not separated AND C-shuffled indistinguishable from refined
thresholds.S3_LIVE: E-SEL-1 Spearman rho separated from C-shuffled AND |rho| >= 0.10
thresholds.S3_DEAD: rho CI includes the shuffled control
thresholds.INDETERMINATE: E-SEL-0 separated but < 0.02 m; tie-break on E-SEL-1 (S3 LIVE => run S1+S2+S3+S4; S3 DEAD => ship S2+S4 only)
thresholds.RED_FLAG_STOP: ADE separated better by > 0.10 m => stop and audit for a leak, do not publish
thresholds.registered_prediction: S1 NEEDS TRAINING (E-SEL-0 not separated, C-shuffled clearly worse) and S3 LIVE at a small rho, 0.10-0.25

pin.why: the Google Drive repo mount was in a whole-mount READ-FAILURE state when this experiment ran, so the prereg could not be `git add`ed BEFORE measuring. The falsifiable object is therefore the git BLOB ID computed from the exact bytes the run used - a deterministic function of content, identical to what `git ls-files -s` must print once the file is staged. Verify: git ls-files -s -- <path> must show git_blob_id_lf.
pin.verify: git hash-object PREREG_S1_CLIMBOUT.md   # must equal git_blob_id_lf

protocol.headline: selection ADE@2s over the survivors, PAIRED vs shipped

C-reproduce.note: the published value is stored rounded to 4 dp, so the admissible deviation is max(1e-6, 5e-5 rounding half-width); the argmax==sel check is the BIT-EXACT half of this control

C-raster.reason: no decode is run in fan-only mode, so no raster is fed to REF-C. The banked fan is the OUTPUT of a decode that already ran at the trained raster on the eval pod (ckpt '/home/nvidia/models/refc-base/ckpt.pt', step 29999).
C-raster.\u26d4: ⛔ THIS CONTROL BECOMES BINDING THE MOMENT A --ckpt DECODE IS ADDED. The only val cache currently reachable off-pod is the w120 256x640 CYLINDRICAL flagship cache; feeding that to REF-C IS R-2026-08-02-a and this control must REFUSE it.

C-monotone.what: a strictly-monotone function of ONE banked scalar has the IDENTICAL argmax, so these two rows are CONTROLS and must reproduce their incumbent selectors exactly

C-permuted-target.what: features permuted INDEPENDENTLY per window, then fit and evaluated LOEO. Must land at the uniform-random floor; a score above it means the split leaks or the protocol is broken.

C-shuffled.what: permute-then-argmax is a uniform pick for ANY score
C-shuffled.status: VACUOUS BY CONSTRUCTION — reported, never load-bearing

objective_diagnostic.status: POST-HOC. Decides NO registered branch and moved no threshold. It exists because EVERY registered fit came back separated ADVERSE — including one whose feature set CONTAINS the incumbent score — which makes 'no information' and 'wrong objective' the two live readings, and they license opposite decisions.
objective_diagnostic.registered_objective: listwise softmax CE vs the oracle INDEX — the objective refc_train.loss_rcls uses
objective_diagnostic.diagnostic_objective: expected ADE under the score's own softmax over survivors (a soft argmax ADE)
